title: KestrelCare Maintenance Visit Service Menu
content:
Every prepaid visit under KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans includes an oil change with the engine oil and quart allowance of the plan level, together with the other services listed for that level. Quarts above the allowance and an upgrade to full synthetic are paid by the holder at the facility, at the charges shown.

## Menu by plan level

| Plan level | Engine oil included | Quarts included per visit | Charge to upgrade a visit to full synthetic (USD) | Charge per extra quart at a network facility (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Maintenance Starter | Conventional | 5 | 24.99 | 9.99 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Basic | Synthetic blend | 5 | 24.99 | 9.99 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard | Synthetic blend | 6 | 14.99 | 9.99 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Plus | Full synthetic | 6 | 0.00 | 9.99 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier | Full synthetic | 7 | 0.00 | 9.99 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max | Full synthetic | 8 | 0.00 | 9.99 |

| Plan level | Tire rotation | Multipoint inspection | Brake measurement | Fluid top-off and tire pressure check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Maintenance Starter | Each visit | Each visit | Not included | Each visit |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Basic | Each visit | Each visit | Not included | Each visit |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard | Each visit | Each visit | Each visit | Each visit |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Plus | Each visit | Each visit | Each visit | Each visit |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier | Each visit | Each visit | Each visit | Each visit |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max | Each visit | Each visit | Each visit | Each visit |

## Partial service

At every plan level, a visit is used even when only part of its services is performed.

## Charge illustrations (hypothetical visits)

The quart counts below are example inputs only.

- A KestrelCare Maintenance Basic visit on an engine that takes 7 quarts: 5 quarts are included, and the holder pays for 2 extra quarts at 9.99 each, a total of 19.98. If the holder also upgrades the visit to full synthetic, the holder pays 24.99 more, so the holder's total at the facility is 44.97.
- A KestrelCare Maintenance Standard visit on an engine that takes 6 quarts with an upgrade to full synthetic: no extra quarts are charged, and the holder pays the upgrade charge of 14.99.
- A KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max visit on an engine that takes 8 quarts: the oil is already full synthetic and all 8 quarts are included, so the holder pays nothing for oil.
- A KestrelCare Maintenance Plus visit at which only the oil change is performed: the visit is still used.
